paragraphs: eleven-x sells a smart parking system to cities, campuses, and private organizations. The product, eXactpark, monitors occupancy in real time and turns it into data for whoever manages the spaces.

Occupancy readings come from a sensor the company says is designed to withstand even the harshest climates. Drivers are told where available spaces are. Operators get real-time overstay alerts to support enforcement. The platform is also aimed at performance parking, dynamic pricing, and curbside management.

Buyers are municipalities, campuses, and other organizations. For public agencies and schools, the company lists cooperative purchasing through Sourcewell. eleven-x was founded in 2014 as a wireless solution provider. It is headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario. Since 2020 its focus has been parking.
